name: Бисквити пълнозърнести (дайджестив)
note: No digestive biscuit in SR Legacy (graham crackers are ~430 kcal / 10 g fat). Values from a typical EU label of wheatmeal digestive biscuits (McVitie's Digestive): 488 kcal, fat 21.3 g, sat 10.3 g, available carbs 62.7 g + fibre 3.6 g (stored as total carbs 66.3), sugars 16.6 g, protein 7.1 g, salt 1.2 g.

name: Стевия
note: Steviol-glycoside tabletop sweetener: 0 kcal and 0 net carbs per serving. USDA 170679 (stevia extract powder) has 0 kcal but lists 100 g carbohydrate from the carrier; set to 0 because a serving is ~1 g and the carrier is usually erythritol.

name: Еритритол
note: Not in SR Legacy. Erythritol is a polyol (~0.2 kcal/g, labelled 0 kcal in the EU). Label shows 100 g carbohydrate as polyols, but it is not metabolised, so carbs set to 0 (net).
